entries.text: You see a heavily muscled, scarred man with a mustache.
entries.source_text: You see a heavily muscled, scarred man with a mustache.

entries.text: You see Lars, the sergeant of the Junktown guards.
entries.source_text: You see Lars, the sergeant of the Junktown guards.

entries.text: He bears the scars of previous wounds, and looks like an old hand.
entries.source_text: He bears the scars of previous wounds, and looks like an old hand.

entries.text: He has scars from knife and bullet injuries. His corded muscles show a man hardened by adversity.

entries.text: You know, it's not wise to try to steal from the guards here in Junktown, punk!

entries.text: Can I help you, stranger?

entries.text: So, what's there to do around here?

entries.text: Can you give me the big picture on Junktown?

entries.text: Who're you?

entries.text: Eergh.

entries.text: If you're in charge of the guards here, I think I have some information for you.

entries.text: Hey! You! We know about you, you monster!

entries.text: Plenty, so long as you stay on our good side. We got Killian Darkwaters' store, where you can do some trading. And there's Gizmo's Casino, if you're a gambler. Or if you just want a drink, you can head on over to the Skum Pitt. Just don't get too rowdy.
entries.source_text:
Plenty, so long as you stay on our good side. We got Killian Darkwaters'
 store, where you can do some trading. And there's Gizmo's Casino, if you're a
 gambler. Or if you just want a drink, you can head on over to the Skum Pitt.
 Just don't get too rowdy.

entries.text: Hey, I like a rowdy time!
entries.source_text: Hey, I like a rowdy time!

entries.text: Well, you'd best keep yourself under control. We're a free town but we don't tolerate stepping on other people's toes. Don't cause any problems and you won't give cause for me and my men to come down on you.
entries.source_text:
Well, you'd best keep yourself under control. We're a free town but we
 don't tolerate stepping on other people's toes. Don't cause any problems and
 you won't give cause for me and my men to come down on you.

entries.text: What a stick in the mud!
entries.source_text: What a stick in the mud!

entries.text: Look, buddy, my job here is to keep the peace, and if I have to break a few heads to do it, then a few people are going to be hurting. So just watch it.
entries.source_text:
Look, buddy, my job here is to keep the peace, and if I have to break a
 few heads to do it, then a few people are going to be hurting. So just watch it.

entries.text: Me and my men here work for Killian Darkwater. We keep some order in this town, dealing with all of the murderers, thieves, and other scumbags who come in from the desert. If you want my advice, you'll also stay away from Gizmo. That fathead runs a crooked operation, but we just haven't been able to prove anything. He and his lackeys, the Skulz, are going to take the fall sometime soon, if Killian has anything to say about it.

entries.text: What a bummer. No fun here at all.
entries.source_text: What a bummer. No fun here at all.

entries.text: Good to know that someone's keeping the peace around here. Thanks.

entries.text: So, what keeps you lawboys from just busting Gizmo and the Skulz?
entries.source_text: So, what keeps you lawboys from just busting Gizmo and the Skulz?

entries.text: Hey, it's our job. But it's good to know that someone appreciates it. Thanks.
entries.source_text:
Hey, it's our job. But it's good to know that someone appreciates it.
 Thanks.

entries.text: Got to do it all proper like. We know that Gizmo runs a rigged operation and all, but we need hard evidence to bring him down. Same with the Skulz; they rough someone up, we bring one or two of 'em in, but nothing changes. We just don't have any direct evidence tying them to any of the killings or muggings.

entries.text: Well, good luck.

entries.text: Hell, if you think you can get some dirt on either of them, we'd appreciate the help. Killian's the one to talk to if you want to talk about Gizmo. But if you can get some info on the Skulz, just come back to me and me and the boys will take care of them.

entries.text: So, you have some info on the Skulz, eh? What can you tell me?

entries.text: They're involved in some muggings and killings here.

entries.text: That's great and all, but I can't just jail them all on one person's say-so. I need hard evidence or inside testimony.

entries.text: Excellent. I'll pick her up for a few questions, and I'm sure that I'll get all the information that I need to put them away.

entries.text: Look, this isn't a game. People are getting hurt here. If you find some real evidence, come back, but otherwise, don't waste my time!

entries.text: If you're not averse to a little skullduggery, I need someone to get some hard evidence on the Skulz, proving that they're involved in illegal activities here. Or you can talk to Killian; he might have some work for you.
